ex.note: This is simply to feel your glutes throughout your workout
At the bottom, let the dumbbell sink you as deep as possible for 2-3s. Then come up, but don’t lock the knees.
Slowly come down
Focus mostly on driving your hips back. As if your butt were to touch the wall behind you. Bent knees are ok, just focus on the hip drive.
This is simply to feel your front delts onwards
Focus on the bottom part, allow the dumbbell to sink into your armpits for maximum contraction.

Focus on pulling towards the middle of your torso. Think about pulling with your elbows.
Keep the elbows tucked in close to your torso, do not flare them out.
Hold 1s at the top, and let the weight sink you down. But don’t lose tension at the bottom
Hold 1s at the top and slowly come back down
This is simply to feel the quads throughout the session

Keep your feet narrow and pointing forwards.
Place your feet lower (as long as you're comfortable).
Objective : knees over toes.
Slowly come down

Push the sled slowly for 5 steps and sprint the rest.
The length should ideally be 15-20m of distance covered.
One rep is one way, the second rep is the same distance back.
Drive with the LEGS!
This is simply to feel your front delts onwards
Have the seat at around 70 degrees of inclination.

Focus on pulling towards the middle of your torso. Think about pulling with your elbows.
Keep the elbows tucked in close to your torso, do not flare them out.
This is simply to feel your glutes throughout your workout
